why: The list and streams bound to agent terminals admit a secretary with its own key from the office computer. Manual streams and other terminal mutations still ask the person or the grant. Typing keeps its separate exact-line words or grant check.
background: The holder types a secretary's line as somebody else's line. It never becomes the person's last line, and the person's note only counts it. So a line a secretary typed cannot later be kept as the person's words.
